Overview

La Rioja is a city in La Rioja with a population of 180,995. La Rioja province’s capital at the foot of the Andes, with the Talampaya National Park and wine production. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
